messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Alliance & Leicester Internet banking users.', 'To update simply use the secure link below to complete the upgrade and improve the functionality of your inbox.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.', 'we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Egg Bank online services.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We are performing scheduled maintenance and upgrades to banking and security software, while encouraging users to update their inbox for improved functionality."}
